spec.what_makes_it_only_tapmart: A photographic source physically hands off to a fixed, working commitment edge: reference to filming to conditional video pay; intact supplied artwork to Instagram eligibility to a work state; a vehicle to a separate placement concept to monthly campaign terms. The three changes of material are one continuous demonstration, not three marketing illustrations.
acceptance: At 1440×900, the first fold contains the entire three-line headline, literal task explanation, equal audience actions, a large filming photograph, one upright implemented phone and the beginning of the graphite Recreate chapter.

The hero photograph is 624×416px, not the current 510×340px. Its meaningful filming action remains unobscured by the phone. The enlarged HTML payment excerpt is labeled Demo opportunity before its amount.

Every earning chapter contains all three explanatory objects in its default screenshot. Post and Drive cannot become empty regions in a full-page capture because another chapter owns the only media stage.

At a pinned chapter capture, the source assembly occupies 872px and its real product commitment occupies 448px, with a 24px junction. No oversized heading is used as a substitute for missing product demonstration.
Recreate shows a still reference, a filming illustration and the $65.00 per-approved-video UI. There is no fabricated video playback.
Post shows the unmodified Story, the explicitly manual Instagram state and the returned eligibility result, then the real open or applied work state. Scrolling never accepts the application.
Drive shows campaign-car-context-01, a separately labeled placement concept and the $240.00 per-month campaign. It does not imply that Maya's owned car has been booked or that an ad is installed.

The business section is one working demonstration with selectable Campaigns and Monthly content views. View person opens a named recipient; a demo approval changes only file approval, leaving publication separate.
On phone, every chapter is a complete vertical explanation with native-size HTML facts. There are no pinned regions, horizontal chapter carousels or miniature desktop inspectors.
The Get paid region distinguishes conditional work, available earnings and a requested payout. All values remain still. No requested payout is presented as paid.
Reduced motion and missing optional media produce finished compositions, not blank stages or instructions to enable animation.
choreography: Desktop enhancement applies only at widths of at least 1200px and viewport heights of at least 800px. At 1440×900, each earning section is 900px high and contains its own 780px sticky panel, top:80px. The pin lasts 120px of native scrolling. Sections touch; there is no additional inter-chapter spacer.

For each chapter, let S be its document top. Progress p runs from 0 at scrollY=S−320 to 1 at scrollY=S+40, clamped across 360px. The first 240px occur during approach; the final 120px occur while pinned. The composition is complete before enhancement, and progress changes emphasis and source geometry only.

Recreate, p=0–0.4: the reference image scales from 224×398px to 176×313px around its top-left origin. Its native-size caption follows the image bottom. The filming photograph moves from x=248,y=32 to x=200,y=0 within the 872px source field. Both originals remain fully visible.

Recreate, p=0.4–0.8: the 24px structural joint behind the fixed work panel resolves from an exposed graphite edge to the cobalt payment edge. This is a background treatment, not a loading bar. From p=0.8–1, the assembly rests. The amount, conditions and action never translate or change state.

Post, p=0–0.4: the intact 288×512px Story moves horizontally from x=112 to x=32 within the source field. The eligibility block remains at x=448. From p=0.4–0.75, its white backing settles by 24px behind stationary text. From p=0.75–1, the fixed work panel remains the destination of the composition; no application or publication state advances.

Drive, p=0–0.45: the 640×427px vehicle photograph moves vertically from y=24 to y=0. From p=0.45–0.75, the separate placement diagram moves 24px into its reserved 208px field. From p=0.75–1, the monthly work panel rests. Artwork never moves onto the photographed vehicle.

No chapter exit fades its content away. The next chapter enters naturally as the previous local sticky panel releases. Background changes happen at these real section boundaries: graphite for making, mineral canvas for supplied creative, underlay for physical inventory.

The business demonstration is not scroll-controlled. Its two explicit mode buttons replace the selected workspace over 180ms, preserving selection within each mode. A focused or edited form cannot be replaced by scroll position.

Below the enhancement breakpoint, with reduced motion, or without JavaScript, use ordinary content-height sections containing the settled compositions. No pinning, translation, source scaling or reserved scroll runway.
